pairs: Alleluja.
Alleluia.
Cantate Domino canticum novum;
Sing to the Lord a new song.
laus ejus in ecclesia sanctorum.
His praise is in the Church of the saints.
Lætetur Israël in eo qui fecit eum,
Let Israel rejoice in him who made them,
et filii Sion exsultent in rege suo.
and let the sons of Zion exult in their king.
Laudent nomen ejus in choro;
Let them praise his name in chorus.
in tympano et psalterio psallant ei.
Let them sing psalms to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.
Quia beneplacitum est Domino in populo suo,
For the Lord is well pleased with his people,
et exaltabit mansuetos in salutem.
and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.
Exsultabunt sancti in gloria;
The saints will exult in glory.
lætabuntur in cubilibus suis.
They will rejoice upon their couches.
Exaltationes Dei in gutture eorum,
The exultations of God will be in their throat,
et gladii ancipites in manibus eorum:
and two-edged swords will be in their hands:
ad faciendam vindictam in nationibus,
to obtain vindication among the nations,
increpationes in populis;
chastisements among the peoples,
ad alligandos reges eorum in compedibus,
to bind their kings with shackles
et nobiles eorum in manicis ferreis;
and their nobles with manacles of iron,
ut faciant in eis judicium conscriptum:
to obtain judgment over them, as it has been written.
gloria hæc est omnibus sanctis ejus.
This is glory for all his saints.
Alleluja.
Alleluia.
